title: Assassin's Creed II
provenance: Reported by arulagarwal (highball-db#1284, 2026-11-17), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXVK, msync, rated 4 of 5: the Ubisoft Connect copy, a written report in the form's shape. Played until a crash, at 1728x1117 and 120 Hz with VSync on. Highball's session count only caught the 10 second AssassinsCreedII.exe stub, which hands off to AssassinsCreedIIGame.exe through Connect. Switching away with Cmd+Tab in fullscreen crashes the game, the DXVK log showing a texture created at 4294935456x4294935327, which the player traces to the minimized window's size. DXVK_FORCE_WINDOWED=1 forced a window the game never resized, so it was reverted. The environment Highball set up for Ubisoft Connect was on DXMT with sync off, and this Direct3D 9 game lagged there (the player says it fell back to Wine's own Direct3D) until the environment was switched to DXVK and msync. Ubisoft Connect installed and signed in on this engine with DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1, WINE_SIMULATE_WRITECOPY=1 and a pin to UbisoftConnect.exe added by hand, although its tile in Highball says Blocked. The first sign in attempts hit Ubisoft's 'Access is temporarily restricted' check, which cleared after a wait. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: A Direct3D 9 game. Reported playable on an M4 Pro with the Ubisoft Connect copy, DXVK and msync on the Wine 11 engine r31. Switching away from the game in fullscreen crashes it, so save first and don't use Cmd+Tab while playing. The environment Highball sets up for Ubisoft Connect uses DXMT with sync off, which lagged in this game until the player switched it to DXVK and msync.

knownIssues.symptom: Switching away with Cmd+Tab in fullscreen crashes the game (M4 Pro, Wine 11 r31, DXVK, highball-db#1284)
knownIssues.cause: the game resizes its render targets to the minimized window's size, per the player. The DXVK log shows a texture of 4294935456x4294935327
knownIssues.fix: don't switch away while playing, save first, and turn on Do Not Disturb so nothing takes focus. DXVK_FORCE_WINDOWED=1 forces a window, but the game doesn't resize it

knownIssues.symptom: Laggy in the environment Highball sets up for Ubisoft Connect, which uses DXMT with sync off (M4 Pro, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1284)
knownIssues.cause: DXMT has no Direct3D 9, so the game falls back to Wine's own Direct3D, per the player, and sync off made it worse
knownIssues.fix: set the environment to DXVK and msync, as the reporter did
